source_text: Est ebrietas sanctorum — spiritu non vino. Apostoli putabantur musto pleni. Discerne calices.
pass_a_gloss: There-is drunkenness of-saints — with-spirit not with-wine. Apostles were-thought with-must full. Distinguish cups.
pass_b_english: There is a saints’ drunkenness — [[Spirit, not wine >> Bible:Ephesians 5:18]]. The apostles seemed [[full of new wine >> Bible:Acts 2:13]]. Distinguish the cups.
